mockPdcPrompt.en: Did you take your controller medicine today?

mockDraftBanner.en: DRAFT — points & vouchers are preview only

mockDonateTransparency.en: Donations go through a verified third-party nonprofit platform. Howse Asthma never stores card details.

mockExternalOnly.en: External donation provider is not wired in design preview.

mockPanicStep1Body.en: Step 1 — Stay with your inhaler. Continue for emergency contacts.

mockPanicStep2Body.en: Design preview: buttons do not place a real call. On device builds, Step 2 uses tel: links.

authErrorGeneric.en: Something went wrong. Please try again.

authBiometricToggleHint.en: Require biometric unlock when opening the app

authBiometricUnavailable.en: Biometrics are not available on this device

providerHomePlaceholder.en: Patient clinical dashboards arrive in a later release. Start by linking patients.

providerLinkIntro.en: Issue an 8-character code (valid 24 hours). The patient enters it, then both sides confirm.

authUseBiometricHint.en: Use Face ID or fingerprint to unlock

authTouchSensorHint.en: Touch sensor or look at camera

mockLocationTrapOnly.en: Location is used for TRAP air quality data only

mockEmergencyOnePerson.en: One person to call in an emergency

mockPairingOptional.en: Optional — you can add this later in Settings

mockTellPractice.en: Tell us about your medical practice

mockNpiFormatOnly.en: Format check only. NPI verification occurs after submission.

mockCredentialsSecure.en: Your credentials are encrypted and stored securely. We never share provider data without consent.

actQ1.en: How much of the time did your asthma keep you from getting as much done at work, school or home?

actQ2.en: How often have you had shortness of breath?

actQ3.en: How often did your asthma symptoms wake you up at night or earlier than usual?

actQ4.en: How often have you used your rescue inhaler or nebulizer medication?

actQ5.en: How would you rate your asthma control?

panicNoAutoDial.en: Buttons open the phone dialer. Calls are never placed automatically.

panicDialFailed.en: Could not open the phone dialer on this device.

s5ActNotice.en: Your answers are saved so you can share them with your clinician. This version of the questionnaire has not been checked against the official scoring, so the app does not show a score.

s5DeleteFailed.en: Could not delete. Please try again.

s5InhalerOneEntryHint.en: Each save is one inhaler-use entry. It is not counted as one puff or one day.

s5LogLegend.en: Each line is one saved entry. Days without entries are “not recorded”, which is different from zero.

s5MedCheckCounts.en: Days used: {a} · not used: {b} · don't remember: {c} · not recorded: {d}

s5MedCheckIntro.en: A self-reported check of whether you used your medicine. It is not based on pharmacy records.

s5MedCheckQuestion.en: Did you use your medicine as planned?

s5MedChooseHint.en: Choose a medication, or “I don't know the medication name”.

s5MedDailyCheckHint.en: Show “Today's medication check-in” on Home. Turn on only if your clinician asked you to use this medicine every day.

s5MedDefaultHint.en: Used when you tap “Log inhaler use” on Home.

s5MedUnknown.en: I don't know the medication name

s5MyMedsHint.en: Names you confirmed, to make logging faster. This is not a dosing recommendation.

s5RecordsLoadFailed.en: Couldn't load your records. Please try again.

s5SaveFailed.en: Could not save. Your entries are still here.

s5SymptomNoneHint.en: Days you don't record are shown as “not recorded”, not as “no symptoms”.

s5UrgentActionPlan.en: If your clinician gave you an asthma action plan, follow it.

s5UrgentIntro.en: If breathing is very hard or not getting better, call 911.

s5UrgentLogHint.en: Optional: save a record that you used your inhaler.

s5UrgentNoContact.en: No emergency contact yet. Add one in Settings → Help.

s6HomeWaterQuestion.en: Was there a leak or flooding at home?

s6ReminderChannel.en: Reminders at the dose times you saved. Not a 30-minute alert.

cnDemoBadgeLong.en: Sample with made-up data. Results are fixed.

cnAuthProfileError.en: You are signed in, but your account could not be loaded ({code}).

cnAuthNameHelper.en: Shown on your packets. You can change it later.

cnAuthCheckEmail.en: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it on this phone, then sign in.

cnAuthResetSent.en: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. Open it on this phone.

cnAuthResetHint.en: Enter your email and we will send a link to set a new password.

cnAuthPrivacyLine.en: Your letters and records are private to your account.

cnAuthErrInvalidCredentials.en: Email or password is not correct.

cnAuthErrNotConfirmed.en: Please confirm your email first. Check your inbox or resend the link.

cnAuthErrExists.en: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.

cnAuthErrWeakPassword.en: Choose a stronger password (at least 8 characters).

cnAuthErrSamePassword.en: Use a password different from your old one.

cnAuthErrRateLimited.en: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.

cnAuthErrEmailNotAuthorized.en: We could not send email to this address right now. Try again later.

cnAuthErrDisabled.en: This sign-in method is turned off.

cnAuthErrSessionExpired.en: Your session ended. Please sign in again.

cnErrNetwork.en: No connection. Check your internet and try again.

cnErrServiceDown.en: The service is not responding. Try again in a few minutes.

cnHomeHeadline.en: Make sense of your insurance letter.

cnHomeSignInLine.en: Saving your cases needs an account.

cnServiceNotConfigured.en: This build is not connected to the server. Only the demo works.

cnStep1Body.en: Take a photo. We find the reason, the next step and the date.

cnStep2Body.en: Match what the letter asks for to your own records.

cnStep3Body.en: Get a one-page doctor summary and a draft review request.

cnNoCasesBody.en: Scan an insurance letter to start.

cnCasesSignInTitle.en: Sign in to see your cases

cnCasesSignInBody.en: Or open the demo to see how it works.

cnNextTryAgain.en: Reading stopped. Open the case to try again.

cnNextFactsToConfirm.en: {count, plural, =1{1 fact to confirm} other{{count} facts to confirm}}

cnDeleteCaseBody.en: This removes the letter pages, the facts read from them, linked record summaries and packets. Your medication and symptom records stay.

cnDeleteFailed.en: Could not delete. Check your connection and try again.

cnDemoIntro.en: Three made-up letters with fixed results, so you can see each step. Nothing is uploaded.

cnUpTooLarge.en: Each file must be {mb} MB or smaller.

cnUpCaseTooLarge.en: All pages together must be {mb} MB or smaller.

cnUpUnsupported.en: Use JPG, PNG or PDF. For HEIC photos, take a new photo here.

cnUpBadFile.en: This file cannot be read. Try another photo or PDF.

cnUpEncrypted.en: This PDF is password-protected. Save an unlocked copy or take photos.

cnCameraUnavailable.en: The camera is not available. You can upload a photo or PDF instead.

cnPhotosUnavailable.en: Photos cannot be opened. Allow photo access in settings, or upload a PDF.

cnFilesUnavailable.en: Files cannot be opened right now. Try again.

cnUploadFailed.en: Upload did not finish. Your pages are still here. Try again.

cnCaptureEmptyTitle.en: Add the pages of your letter

cnCaptureTips.en: Lay the page flat in good light and fit all four corners in the frame. Add every page, in order.

cnUploadConsent.en: Uploading sends these pages to the CoverNote server, where an AI service reads them for you. You can delete the case at any time.

cnPdfPages.en: File {n} · PDF, {count, plural, =1{1 page} other{{count} pages}}

cnServiceUnavailableBody.en: The letter reader is not set up right now. Your pages are saved; try again later.

cnNeedNewPagesBody.en: Take clearer photos or use fewer pages, then upload again.

cnPagesKept.en: Your pages are saved. Nothing was changed.

cnReadingBody.en: When it is done, you check what we found against the letter.

cnReadingLeaveOk.en: You can leave this screen. Reading continues and your case is saved.

cnLetterPagesRead.en: {count, plural, =1{1 page read} other{{count} pages read}}

cnPagesHardToRead.en: Hard to read: page {list}. Check these facts carefully or retake the page.

cnCheckDetailsHint.en: Compare each value with your letter. Tap a quote to see where it came from.

cnItemsLeftToCheck.en: {count, plural, =1{Check 1 more item to continue} other{Check {count} more items to continue}}

cnNoReasonFound.en: No reason was found in the letter.

cnNextDenial.en: {count, plural, =0{Ask your care team to request a review. The letter does not list specific items.} =1{Ask your care team to request a review. The letter lists 1 item to send.} other{Ask your care team to request a review. The letter lists {count} items to send.}}

cnNextInfoRequest.en: {count, plural, =0{Send the information the plan asked for by the date below.} =1{Send the 1 item the plan asked for by the date below.} other{Send the {count} items the plan asked for by the date below.}}

cnNextReauth.en: Note when the current approval ends and ask your care team to start the renewal.

cnNextFinal.en: This is a final decision. CoverNote does not draft a first review request for it. Ask the plan or your care team about the options the letter lists.

cnNextEob.en: This looks like a bill or benefits statement, not a denial. Check it with the plan's member services.

cnNextUncertain.en: First confirm what kind of letter this is, above.

cnDatePassed.en: This date has passed. Call the plan to ask what you can still do.

cnNeedReceivedDate.en: The letter gives {days} calendar days from the day you received it. When did it arrive?

cnDateConflict.en: The letter gives different dates. Ask the plan which one applies, then pick it.

cnDateUnclear.en: The wording is unclear or counts business days, so CoverNote does not calculate it. Ask the plan for the exact date.

cnNoDeadline.en: No review deadline was found in the letter.

cnReplyBy.en: Reply to the information request by {date} (from the letter)

cnTypeAsWritten.en: Type it exactly as the letter shows.

cnCheckThisValue.en: This value looks unusual. Compare it with the letter.

cnNoRecordsToLink.en: No records from the last 30 days to link. You can still mark who has this item.

cnLinkNote.en: Your own records support the request. They do not replace clinic notes or test results.

cnMedLine.en: {taken} taken / {notTaken} not taken / {unknown} unknown of {scheduled} scheduled doses

cnSymptomLine.en: Symptoms on {days} days, night waking on {night} days ({entries} of {total} days logged)

cnPmLine.en: PM2.5 data for {days} of {total} days; {high} days above AQI 100

cnNoItemsListed.en: The letter does not list specific items. You can add your own.

cnLocalContextNote.en: Optional context. Not a measurement at your home and not a cause of symptoms.

cnErrNotSavedYet.en: Your latest changes are not saved yet. Check your connection and try again.

cnPacketChangedMeanwhile.en: Facts or records changed while the packet was being made. Generate it again.

cnPacketFailed.en: The packet could not be made. Try again.

cnBeforeSharingBody.en: This file has your name and health details. Share it only with your care team or your plan. Sharing does not submit anything for you.

cnPacketNoDraftFinal.en: For a final decision, the packet has the doctor summary only. No first-level review draft is made.

cnPacketNoDraftEob.en: For a bill or benefits statement, the packet has the doctor summary only.

cnPacketNoDraftReauth.en: For a renewal notice, the packet has the doctor summary only, to help your care team renew.

cnPacketNoDraftOther.en: Unless the letter is a denial or an information request, the packet has the doctor summary only.

cnPartDraft.en: Review request draft (for your care team to complete)

cnPacketEvidenceCount.en: {count, plural, =0{No record summaries added} =1{1 record summary added} other{{count} record summaries added}}

cnIncludeLetterText.en: Add the letter text as an appendix

cnPacketStale.en: Facts or records changed since the last packet. Generate it again to update.

cnSentExplain.en: Record when and how it was sent. CoverNote does not send it or track a decision.

cnCtxIntro.en: Air readings from a named source and things you noticed, kept separate. Add them to a case only if they help explain your records.

cnCtxReadingsNote.en: Regional readings for the day they were observed. They do not measure traffic exhaust at your home.

cnCtxReportsNote.en: Your own reports. They are not measurements.

cnCtxHumidityNote.en: Outdoor humidity is weather data. It does not show dampness or mold inside your home.

cnCtxSourceHelp.en: Where the number came from, for example AirNow or a local monitor

cnRecordsSignInBody.en: Sign in to keep medication, symptom and local context records.

cnRecLocalContextSub.en: Air readings and what you noticed

cnUrgentHelpSub.en: Steps for a breathing emergency and calling 911

cnRecordsUnknownNote.en: Days without an entry stay unknown. They are not counted as missed.

cnDeleteAccountBody.en: This permanently deletes your account, cases, uploaded letters, packets and records. It cannot be undone.

cnDeleteAccountFailed.en: The account could not be deleted. Try again later.

cnAboutBody.en: CoverNote helps you read insurance letters about medicines and prepare papers for your care team. It does not submit anything to your plan, does not decide coverage, and is not medical advice.

cnErrServiceUnavailable.en: The letter reader is not available right now.

cnErrBusy.en: The service is busy. Wait a minute and try again.

cnErrSlow.en: Reading took too long. Try again.

cnErrUnreadable.en: The pages could not be read. Retake them in better light.

cnErrTooManyPages.en: Too many pages. Upload up to 10.

cnErrTooLarge.en: The files are too large. Use fewer or smaller pages.

cnErrStale.en: This case changed on another device. Showing the latest version.

cnErrAttempts.en: Reading failed several times. Replace the pages or try again later.

cnErrDemoUpload.en: The demo cannot read files. Sign in to scan your own letter.

cnLanguageNote.en: Some text was translated by software and may have mistakes. Medicine names, doses, dates and quotes from your letter are never translated.

cnPacketEnglishNote.en: The packet is written in English so your care team can read it.

cnReasonMissingInformation.en: The plan says it did not get all the information it needed.

cnReasonStepTherapy.en: The plan wants you to try other medicines first.

cnReasonMedicalNecessity.en: The plan says it could not confirm that this medicine is medically needed.

cnReasonFormulary.en: The plan says this medicine is not on its list of covered medicines.

cnReasonQuantityLimit.en: The plan says the amount asked for is more than it covers.

cnReasonEligibility.en: The plan says this is not covered under its coverage rules.

cnReasonOther.en: The letter gives another reason. Open the quote from the letter to read it.
